title: Rough Transmission Shifts
summary: Feedback centers on transmission behavior, with some praise for gear changes but several complaints about rough, harsh, or poorly timed shifts, while many examples are too ambiguous or off-topic to classify clearly.

positive.summary: One review praises the transmission for shifting gears very well.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe rough upshifts, noticeable kicks on downshifts, and hesitation or shifts occurring at the wrong times.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined examples mention rough shifts or rough transitions without enough context, and some fragments appear unrelated to transmission behavior.

limitations: Several undetermined fragments are ambiguous or unrelated to transmission shifting, which reduces topic coherence.
The negative sample is small, and one negative fragment appears unrelated to transmission behavior, so examples are insufficient to characterize the issue more precisely.
Some example text may reference another vehicle or a copied source, limiting confidence that all fragments cleanly describe the G70 transmission experience.
